secrets.description: On-chain address that incoming sends are echoed back from. Generate with `usernode-cli account generate`; paste the `address` field here.
Secret key paired with ECHO_APP_PUBKEY. Used by the echo signer to send replies. Never logged or returned via the API.
Sidecar usernode RPC endpoint. Defaults to the in-network node service.
Directory for the anomaly-detection SQLite store. Should point at a mounted volume so historical baselines survive restarts. Falls back to in-memory (non-durable) if unwritable.
Set to 1 to seed a synthetic anomaly-detection baseline on boot. Staging only (ignored in production) so the detector has history to compare against in a fresh PR container.
